svg.title: Pipe boot flashing around a plumbing vent
svg.desc: A plumbing vent pipe coming through the roof, with some shingles cut away. The pipe boot is a flat metal or plastic flange with a rubber collar that hugs the pipe. The bottom edge of the flange sits on top of the shingles below it, so water runs off onto them. The top and sides of the flange slide under the shingles above, and its nails are up where those shingles cover them. Every lap points downhill, the same way the shingles do. Illustration, not a photo of an actual job. Layer thicknesses are exaggerated so each one can be seen.
